source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 4, 4. Ἱστορικῶς μὲν ἐπανῆλθεν ἐπὶ τὰ συμβάντα ἐπὶ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας, πρὸς δὲ διάνοιαν περὶ τοῦ λιμοῦ τοῦ διδασκαλικοῦ λόγου φησίν.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Historically he has returned upon the things that happened upon the captivity; but toward the sense he speaks about the famine of the teaching word.
pass_b_english: Historically he has returned upon the things that happened upon the captivity; but toward the sense he speaks about the famine of the teaching word (Lamentations 4:4).

choices.why: Origen allegorizes God’s word as sword at Lam 4:9.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
